titles.title: Lord I Give You My Heart
This is My Desire

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
This is my desire
To honour You
Lord, with all my heart
I worship You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All I have within me
I give you praise
All that I adore is in You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Lord I give You my heart
I give You my soul
I live for You alone

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Every breath that I take
Every moment I'm awake
Lord have Your way in me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
And I will live
And I will live for you
